item.title: Overgrown Bushes, 12th September
item.description:
The bushes at the front of the property have become significantly overgrown and are beginning to obstruct access to the bins and doorway. The rear of the property is in a similar condition, with overgrown foliage affecting the pathway and making access difficult. Both areas are unsightly and give the property a neglected appearance. This is also a recurring issue, and the repeated failure to maintain the foliage needs to be addressed. Please arrange for the overgrown bushes and foliage at both the front and rear of the property to be cut back and properly maintained to prevent the issue from recurring.

item.title: The filthiest place in Greenwich - Brookhill Rd, 12th September
item.description:
I've lived in Woolwich almost 20 years and I am ashamed to bring any friends or family down Brookhill Rd as it looks like in a 3rd world country. Currently there's rubbish under most of the trees, empty bottles after laughing gas, black bin bags next to the nurserry. It's not a side street but a very busy road which Grrenwich council has forgotten about. I never see anyone cleaning it . Rubbish on the payment lays uncollected for weeks. Can you please arrange a regular clean of this road as it's one of the busiest one in Woolwich.?

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Brookhill Road, Woolwich
